name: test_plan_resolve
description: Deterministic test_cycle decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

discovered.description: Discovery output (or a bare command list) to fall back to when no operator override is supplied. Accepts either a raw array of command objects or an object with a 'commands' array.

priorVerification.description: A prior verification's command list, merged as a carried obligation alongside 'discovered'. Same shape as 'discovered'.

testCommands.description: Operator-supplied override commands, taking precedence over everything else. Each item may be a bare argv array or a full command object.

discoveryOutcome.description: Discovery outcome carried in from test_discover, e.g. discovered, no_tests_required, configuration_blocked.

discoveryReason.description: Discovery blocked reason carried in from test_discover, echoed back unchanged.

selection.description: Discovery selection strategy (e.g. documented-guide) used to attribute commandSource as repository_guide.

testPlanTemplate.description: Inline JSON string of an operator test-plan template, used only when testCommands is not supplied. A value starting with '@' or invalid JSON is treated as absent.

agentCommands.description: An already-validated agent test-command proposal, used only as a last resort when discovery and prior obligations are both empty.

testPlanTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied testPlanTemplate; only used for a log line, has no effect on the resolved plan.

commands.description: The resolved command plan for this candidate, deduplicated by argv.

required.description: Commands carried forward from priorVerification as still-required obligations.

commandSource.description: Which authority supplied the resolved commands.

discoveryOutcome.description: Resolved discovery outcome: normalized to 'discovered' when commands exist and the input outcome was discovered/no_tests_required, or when an override/agent proposal itself supplies authority over a blocked/absent outcome.

discoveryReason.description: Discovery blocked reason, echoed through unchanged (empty string when none was given).
